articles.summary: Company to Host Conference Call at 8:30 AM ET on Wednesday, May 15, 2024 TROY, Mich., May 14, 2024 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Conifer Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: CNFR) (“Conifer” or the “Company”) today announced results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2024. First Quarter 2024 Financial Highlights (compared to the prior year period) Combined ratio was 96.7%, an improvement of 2.8 percentage points from Q1 2023 Expense ratio improved 2.6 percentage points to 34.7% Net investment income increased
articles.title: Conifer Holdings Reports 2024 First Quarter Financial Results
